desc:
Flip it. Don't remove it.
Flip your thermal or NV 90° out of the line of sight without taking it off the rail, then flip it straight back to the same zero. It clamps to any Picatinny rail with two screws and weighs just 66 g. Designed and made in Estonia.

Why the QDF
A quick-detach flip mount whose only job is to carry your thermal or NV on the weapon and get it out of the way fast. One flip stows the device, one flip brings it back on the same zero, and the whole ecosystem shares one adapter.

Flip-to-side

Flip out, flip back

Flip the device 90° clear in one motion to engage close or dynamic targets with your red dot, then flip it back to the exact same zero. No button to flip back, you just overcome the detent.

Run it either hand

The unlock button sits on the left to clear limited top-rail space, and every function is reachable left or right handed, even reaching over the thermal. A front QD lever drops the device off fast.

One adapter, three mounts

The custom dovetail takes the Falconclaw QDA series. The QDF (rifle), QDB (helmet bridge) and QDM (J-arm) all share the same QDAs, so one device moves between them in seconds.

7000 alloy, made in Estonia

7000-series aluminium, type III hard anodised, with stainless steel hardware, 66 g. If wobble ever develops after long use, the included flathead screw locks the flip closed and turns it into a rigid dovetail mount.

-66 g Weight
-90 ° Flip angle tool-less stow/deploy
-1.63 in Centerline. 41 mm, default height
